notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Sakura-Tribe Scout does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger from step 2, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat.
